what_it_does: H3Match solves a tedious problem in chip design: finding repeated circuit patterns to simplify or verify designs. Traditional methods miss matches (high false negatives) or take too long. H3Match models circuits as hypergraphs—networks where edges can connect more than two nodes—capturing circuit structure more faithfully. It uses a graph neural network for fast approximate matching to eliminate obviously wrong candidates, then uses optimization (MINLP—Mixed Integer Nonlinear Programming) for precise verification. The approximate results seed the exact solver, dramatically speeding it up without false positives.
